name: callouts
description: Makes what needs you impossible to miss: `> [!ACTION]`, `> [!ASK]`, `> [!INPUT]` and `> [!SECRET]` blocks in a reply draw as bright yellow cards with a flag and stay listed above the prompt, each with its answer, until answered or dismissed. A key typed into a SECRET shows as dots and goes straight into its .env file, never the chat. `> [!DONE]` draws as a finished banner. Colours follow the Devdeck theme
